mentions.name: Home Manager over Text
mentions.description: A text-message-based home manager for grocery shopping. Users text items to their shopping list as they think of them and text 'fulfill' to place an order. The service uses the Kroger API and reasons over returned items to pick products, favoring items ordered before and using texted family preferences for first-time items. Setup happens by texting 'connect' and a zip code to set the store, and commands like 'seasonal' add seasonal items to the cart. There is no website or UI—it is entirely text-based—and it currently only works if the user's main store is in the QFC/Kroger family.
mentions.audience: People whose main grocery store is in the QFC/Kroger family
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on making a home manager over text. You text your shopping list as you remember things to buy and when you want to order, you text fulfill. I am using Kroger api behind the scene and reasoning over items that are returned, best picks are the ones that you have already ordered before and the first time item picks are governed by the family preferences you have texted.
